metrics.name: tokens.input
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: Tokens the agent would have received without LeanCTX (the baseline).

metrics.name: tokens.output
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Tokens LeanCTX actually delivered to the agent.

metrics.name: tokens.saved
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: tokens.input − tokens.output, after bounce corrections.

metrics.name: savings.measured
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Saved tokens whose evidence class is measured (counted by a local tokenizer).

metrics.name: savings.estimated
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: Saved tokens that rest on an estimate (approximated, statistical, declared or unclassified evidence).

metrics.name: savings.estimated_low
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: Lower end of the range of savings.estimated.

metrics.name: savings.estimated_high
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: Upper end of the range of savings.estimated.

metrics.name: savings.evidenced
metrics.label: evidenced
metrics.formula: The part of the savings backed by a gateway receipt or provider reconciliation.

metrics.name: savings.overhead
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Tokens LeanCTX itself added (instructions, tool schemas, hints). Net own savings = savings.measured + savings.estimated − savings.overhead, and may be negative. The provider cache is not part of it (ledger.cache_discount).

metrics.name: calls.tool_calls
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Tool calls through LeanCTX.

metrics.name: calls.cache_reads
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Re-reads that could be served from the read cache.

metrics.name: calls.cache_hits
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Re-reads served from the read cache. Cache-hit rate = cache_hits ÷ cache_reads.

metrics.name: compression.original
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Tokens of tool output before compression.

metrics.name: compression.compressed
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Tokens of tool output after compression. Compression = 1 − compressed ÷ original.

metrics.name: ledger.reduction
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: Savings from shortening context.

metrics.name: ledger.cache_discount
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: The provider's cache discount the proxy observed; not LeanCTX's own saving.

metrics.name: ledger.correction
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: Corrections for content the agent had to fetch again.

metrics.name: ledger.edit
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: Savings from edit tools.

metrics.name: ledger.other
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: Every other ledger entry.

metrics.name: guards.secrets_redacted
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Secrets replaced before the model saw them.

metrics.name: guards.pii_redacted
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: PII values masked by the gateway.

metrics.name: guards.injection_flags
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Tool outputs flagged for prompt injection.

metrics.name: guards.content_withheld
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Sources the gateway withheld.

metrics.name: guards.paths_blocked
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Paths outside the project jail that were refused.

metrics.name: guards.shell_blocked
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Shell commands the allowlist refused.

metrics.name: guards.partial_inspections
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Sources delivered although a detector did not inspect all of them.

metrics.name: policy.blocked
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Refusals by rules in force, per rule.

metrics.name: policy.would_block
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Refusals a rule in monitor mode would make, before it goes live.

metrics.name: refetch.truncated
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Outputs shortened by a filter (read mode or compression pattern).

metrics.name: refetch.refetched
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Shortened outputs the agent fetched back in full. Re-fetch rate = refetched ÷ truncated.

metrics.name: unregulated.calls
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Calls no enforcing rule covers: programs a command ran, tool calls of a host family without an intercepting hook, and calls relayed to MCP servers.
metrics.source: the gateway's decision record: no enforcing rule matched

metrics.name: sessions.started
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Agent sessions started.

metrics.name: hosts.tool_calls
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Tool calls per agent host.

metrics.name: spend.requests
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Model requests where the engine measures spend.

metrics.name: spend.input_tokens
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Model input tokens.

metrics.name: spend.output_tokens
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Model output tokens.

metrics.name: spend.cached_tokens
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Model input tokens served from the provider cache.

metrics.name: spend.usd_micros
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.formula: Cost at list price (tokens × price table below, the fallback price for unknown models); estimated · list price, never an invoice.

metrics.name: knowledge.facts_current
metrics.label: measured
metrics.formula: Knowledge facts in the vault at the end of the period (a level, not a sum).

metrics.name: engines.active
metrics.label: derived
metrics.formula: Engines that reported at least one hour in the period (Hive only).

sent_only_when: the MCP server name is sent only when the workspace's policy names it
retention: Hourly detail and its daily rollup are kept without a time limit, until the customer deletes them (per engine or all) or the account is deleted. Exports (CSV, JSONL) are available at any time.
